strategy.primary: cEDH turbo/midrange: fast mana, tutors and dense free interaction toward Worldgorger Dragon + a reanimation Aura (unbounded mana, repeated Evelyn exile triggers), Thassa's Oracle + Consultation/Tainted Pact, or Underworld Breach + LED/Petal + Brain Freeze.
strategy.secondary: Evelyn as a flash value engine: each entry exiles the top card of every library and she plays one per turn, with Leyline of Anticipation and Valley Floodcaller letting her work on opponents' turns.

commander_oracle_snapshots.name: Evelyn, the Covetous
commander_oracle_snapshots.oracle_text:
Flash
Whenever Evelyn or another Vampire you control enters, exile the top card of each player's library with a collection counter on it.
Once each turn, you may play a card from exile with a collection counter on it if it was exiled by an ability you controlled, and you may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast it.

identity.why: Flash exile engine with one play per turn.
The commander-flavoured combo: loops re-trigger Evelyn.
Flash for everything, so Evelyn plays on opponents' turns.
Kills Evelyn into two token copies and four triggers.
Gives Evelyn's casts convoke and loots.
